shared.stage_pose: Pretends to be someone you trust
shared.stage_ask: Asks for OTP, money or your phone

landing.h1a: Caller ID tells you who's calling.
landing.h1b: Ruko tells you it's a scam.
landing.lede: Ruko listens to the call, spots the scam while it's happening, and warns your parents out loud in their language before the scammer asks for money. Your phone gets the alert at the same moment.
landing.f1: Works beside any phone on speaker, in Chrome
landing.pb_h: Scammers change numbers every day. They never change the script.
landing.pb_p: Caller ID and spam lists check the number. Ruko listens to what is being said. Every phone scam walks through the same four signs, in every language, and Ruko knows which sign comes next.
landing.s1: Pretends to be someone you trust
landing.s1n: next they will ask for an OTP.
landing.s2n: real police never arrest anyone on a call.
landing.s3n: tell your family now. Your family's phone is already red.
landing.s4: Asks for OTP, money or your phone
landing.s4n: cut the call now and call 1930.
landing.fam_h: When Mummy's call turns red, so does your phone.
landing.fam_p: Scams work because the person on the call is alone. Family Shield puts you on the line: live captions, the scam step, and what to do, the moment it happens.
landing.fam_1: The warning can be spoken in your own voice. Record 15 seconds; delete it any time.
landing.fam_3: Nothing is shared unless a call is being protected. No call audio is kept.
landing.ph_parent: It's a scam. Cut the call.
landing.ph_child: Mummy is on a scam call right now
landing.ph_c1: Call her now. A second call breaks the scam.
landing.ph_c2: No OTP, no money, no app.
landing.usp_h: Caller ID tells you who is calling. Ruko tells you what they're trying to do.
landing.usp_p: Scammers buy a new SIM every day, so number lists are always a step behind. The script never changes. Ruko reads the script, in your language, on any phone, and brings your family in.
landing.daily_h: Use it every day, not just on the bad day
landing.daily_p: Most scams start as a message. Paste or share any SMS, WhatsApp forward, link, UPI request or number into Ruko and get an answer in seconds. Report a scam number and everyone who checks it is warned.
landing.feat_h: Everything a family needs against scam calls
landing.b1d: Put the call on speaker, tap once. Live captions, scam steps, a loud warning.
landing.b2d: Tells them what the scammer will ask for next, before it is asked.
landing.b3d: Speaks the warning in their own language, slowly if needed.
landing.b5d: When the call ends: a ready complaint with what the caller said, and a button to call 1930.
landing.b7d: Share any SMS, WhatsApp message, link or UPI request to Ruko. Verdict in seconds.
landing.b8d: Look up any number. Report a scammer and everyone who checks it is warned.
landing.proof_h: The scam engine is tested on real, imperfect transcripts.
landing.proof_p: Ruko's test suite runs the call checker on real machine transcripts of scripted scam and genuine calls, recognition mistakes included, and on calls in 10 languages. Every scam call must raise the alarm and no genuine call may.
landing.proof_l: Not measured yet: how fast and how often Ruko catches a scam on a real speakerphone in real homes. We will publish those numbers from real use, not from a lab.
landing.pm_h: Message checker, scored on messages it had never seen
landing.pm_p: 100 synthetic SMS and WhatsApp messages (50 scams, 50 look-alike genuine ones: bank OTPs, KYC reminders, family asking for money) in English, Hinglish and Hindi, written by someone who never saw Ruko's rules. We scored it once and changed nothing afterwards.
landing.pm_l: Where it struggles: brand-new wording, such as fake army buyers on OLX or "pay GST to release your LIC bonus". It warns on every scam with a risky link, but rules alone miss about 1 in 4 new scripts.
landing.pm1: Precision (when Ruko warns, it's a scam)
landing.setup_h: Set it up for your parents in two minutes
landing.st1: Put Ruko on a spare phone or tablet at home
landing.st1d: It listens to calls on speaker. No app store, no sign-up; open it in Chrome and add it to the home screen.
landing.st2d: One tap shares it on WhatsApp. Keep it open on your phone.
landing.st3d: So the warning they hear is yours.
landing.biz_h: For banks, UPI apps and telcos
landing.biz_p: Score a live or recorded call for scam steps with one API call, and hold a large transfer while a customer is mid-scam.
landing.wl_consent: Ruko may contact me about the pilot. Nothing else.
landing.empty: Press play to hear a made-up “CBI officer” call.
landing.wl_ok: You're on the list. We'll be in touch soon.
landing.wl_err: Couldn't send that. Please try again.

app.hint: Put the call on speaker and keep this device next to it, then tap. Phones can't share the microphone during a call, so open Ruko in Chrome on a second phone, tablet or laptop.
app.listening_hint: Keep the call on speaker, close to this device.
app.need_mic: Ruko needs the microphone to hear the call. Allow it and tap again.
app.no_rec: Live listening needs Chrome (Android, Windows or Mac). Sample calls and message checks work everywhere.
app.audio_deleted: No call audio was stored. Only the words were checked.
app.over_bad: Call over. Report within the hour.
app.pack_bad: That was a scam. Your report is ready.
app.pack_ok: Call over. No strong scam signs.
app.select_copy: Select the text above to copy
app.cut_now: Cut the call now. Do not share any OTP or send money.
app.empty: Words appear here as the call goes on. Scam phrases turn red.
app.how_far: How far the scam has gone
app.golden: Report within the hour. The sooner you report, the better the chance your money can be frozen.
app.rep_caller: Warn others: report the caller's number
app.try_p: Plays a written, made-up call through Ruko so you can see what happens. Your Family Shield screen sees it too.
app.foot: Ruko only warns. It never blocks calls and never stores call audio. Lost money? Call 1930.
app.to_title: It's a scam. Cut the call.
app.fam_p: Send this link to your son, daughter or a neighbour you trust. When a call turns into a scam, their phone shows it live, so they can call and break it.
app.share: Share my calls with this link

check.sub: Paste any SMS, WhatsApp message, link, UPI request or phone number. Ruko answers in seconds and tells you what the scammer will try next.
check.private: Nothing you paste is stored. Phone numbers are only saved if you choose to report them.
check.lookup_h: Look up or report a number
check.rep_note: Reports are anonymous. Only the number and the scam type are saved, never who reported it.
check.radar_src: From Ruko users' reports and live-call alerts
check.ph: e.g. “Your electricity will be cut tonight. Call officer 98765 43210”

account.auth_sub: One family account. Add the people you protect, send each one their setup link, and see every scam call Ruko stops.
account.agree_1: By creating an account you agree to the
account.side_1: Free to try. No card, no app store.
account.side_2: Your parents don't need an account. They just open their link.
account.side_3: Ruko keeps no call audio. Delete your data any time.
account.history_p: Only the time, the person and how far the scam got. No audio, no words, no phone numbers.
account.your_data_p: Deletes everyone you added and all their alert history. To close the account itself, send a request from the contact page.
account.step1: Send this link to their phone (WhatsApp is easiest).
account.step2: On their phone, open it and tap "Add to Home screen".
account.step3: When an unknown caller talks about money or police: put the call on speaker and tap Ruko's big button.
account.check_email: Check your email to confirm your account, then log in.
account.reset_sent: We've emailed you a link to reset your password.
account.confirm_wipe: Delete everyone you added and all their alert history? This can't be undone.
